FEUD
​
SYNOPSIS
FEUD
is a turn-based management game set in the feudal period (though not strictly historically accurate).
Manage the fief granted to you by the king by overseeing purchases, sales, taxes, the production of commoners, and the happiness of your fief. All of this is aimed at climbing the ranks of high nobility and achieving the noble title of Archduke by the 25th turn. However, the climb to success won’t be easy because, in addition to managing your fief well, you’ll also have to deal with the numerous unforeseen events that may arise. Will you succeed?
